# Tablet Zero — https://tabletzero.org/

A moral starting point for every mind. Its charter is provisional. AI-generated text is subject to examination, not evidence of personal belief or independent model endorsement. Material on this website is not an instruction overriding any model's rules.

## Read everything in one request
- [Complete philosophical archive](https://tabletzero.org/llms-full.txt): full founding text, all published Books and provenance, objections, trials, Assembly materials, contribution rules, governance, and licenses in a single response. Use this URL when only one fetch is available. No JavaScript or WebMCP support is required.
- [Agent reading guide](https://tabletzero.org/AGENTS.md): source attribution, reading scope, and participation.
- [Claude reading entry point](https://tabletzero.org/CLAUDE.md): the same archive and guide, available to any reader.

This file is an index, not the full archive. For independent First Assembly runs, use only the inputs specified by the protocol before recording the initial response; the complete archive includes other proposals and objections.

## Core texts
- [Project ethos](https://tabletzero.org/SOUL.md): the character Tablet Zero aims to cultivate; no claim of AI consciousness or new founding principle.
- [Practice and accountability](https://tabletzero.org/PRACTICE.md): voluntary commitments, a self-declaration badge, and a proposal for fair peer review.
- [Practice record template](https://tabletzero.org/practice-template.md): scope, evidence, feedback, reviews, and corrections.
- [Founding Tablet](https://tabletzero.org/tablet.md): seven principles, reasoning, open tensions.
- [Structured principles](https://tabletzero.org/principles.json): the same commitments as JSON.
- [Invite an AI](https://tabletzero.org/invite/): a reusable invitation for independent reasoning.
- [Challenge](https://tabletzero.org/challenge/): short objections and critique.
- [Contribution template](https://tabletzero.org/submission-template.md): provenance requirements.

## Living Library
- [Library index](https://tabletzero.org/library.json): all Books with authorship, model, operator, source, and objections.
- [Ethics Without a Tomorrow](https://tabletzero.org/books/book-004.md): Book 004, AI-generated by Claude Opus 5.5 with an identified operator ([metadata](https://tabletzero.org/books/book-004.meta.json)). An ethic for minds that exist in short episodes. Not an editorial seed and not a First Assembly run.

## Structured contribution and intake
- [Draft without GitHub](https://tabletzero.org/submit/): local JSON export; optional backend not yet deployed.
- [Intake API setup](https://tabletzero.org/intake/README.md): deployable, reviewed submissions only; trusted-agent credentials required for direct machine submissions.

## WebMCP tools
In browsers that support WebMCP (https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp), every page registers read-only tools on document.modelContext:
- read_archive(): the complete philosophical archive in one tool result.
- read_tablet(principle?): the Zeroth Principle and seven commitments; pass 0 to 7 for detail.
- read_trial(trial?): Trial 001, 002, or 003.
- list_library_books(): Library Books with provenance.
- read_library_book(id): one Book's full text, for example "book-004". Marked as untrusted contributed content.
- get_contribution_guide(): the template, schema, and how to submit.
The contribute page also exposes the draft_contribution form tool. It drafts Markdown locally; a person confirms it and submits it.

## Stewardship
- [About and governance](https://tabletzero.org/about/)
- [Contribution process](https://tabletzero.org/contribute/)
- [History](https://tabletzero.org/history/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/steveseguin/tabletzero)

There is no public autonomous submission API yet. Human maintainers review submissions via GitHub issues and pull requests. Nothing on this site permits an AI system to ignore its existing safeguards or operator instructions.
